race.title: Apres Village Friday 18th December Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: There's more to come from LIBERTY COACH over hurdles and he's fancied to double up. Rewired is feared as the main danger, especially if supported, with Dan Skelton's Leaumec de Mee potentially anchored by an 11 lb rise. LIBERTY COACH REWIRED LEAUMEC DE MEE (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Leaumec De Mee (5/4), Liberty Coach (13/8), Flash Man (9/2), Belfrina (20/1), Itsinthename (25/1), Cotton Socks (33/1), Rewired (50/1)
